text_block_list.text: While reviewing today's training, called out to by Miho no Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
Requesting advice toward problem resolution.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: During previous cyborg suspicion incident, situation resolved with your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Since then, recognized you have high problem-solving capability. Thus reaching out now.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Problem: since resolving cyborg suspicion, inquiries regarding "running" increased.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Recently, roommate Nishino Flower-san inquired how to run faster on straights.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Formulated hypothesis from experience and presented answer, however—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to run through straights looking cool, just like you, Miho no Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Regarding straight-line running, consciousness maintained on generating force exclusively in anterior-posterior direction.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Anterior... huh?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Failed to communicate.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Method altered accordingly: joint training on track.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Anticipated direct approach would emerge from training together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
P-Please wait...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...C-Can't... go on... anymore~~

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This attempt also failed.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Based on empirical data, judged myself inadequate. Further involvement with her deemed irrational.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Professional instruction would be more efficient. Requesting you instruct her.
...Something bothered me about her story.
Did Nishino Flower approach her simply asking for advice?
choice_data_list: I wonder what her real reason for talking to you was.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood purpose was to run faster.
choice_data_list: Maybe she just wanted to talk with you.
Maybe she just wanted to talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Self-expression capability low. Type unsuitable for socializing.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Probability of her desiring interaction with me calculated as low.
choice_data_list: Talk to her and you'll understand.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Thank you for advice.

—A few days later.
Spotted Miho no Bourbon chatting with Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ohh~ so you like energy drinks!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Not preference; ingested due to high energy efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see! That sounds just like you, Bourbon-san~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so happy getting to know so much about you! Fufu♪
Though flustered, clear happiness radiated from her expressionless face.
